reports.title: Zebra Technologies Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Mr. Burns added, "We remain confident in the growth drivers supporting our business, and our ability to capture the opportunity ahead. We are driving operating productivity as we scale to meet the strong demand we are seeing for

our solutions. Together, these efforts support our increased full-year outlook and position us well for sustainable profitable growth as we continue to benefit from trends in automation and Physical AI."
The Company expects fourth quarter sales growth between 10% and 14% compared to the prior year. This expectation includes approximately 150 basis points favorable impact from foreign currency.

Adjusted EBITDA margin for the fourth quarter is expected to be approximately 22%. Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share are expected to be in the range of $5.00 to $5.40. This assumes an adjusted effective tax rate of approximately 19%.
Free Cash Flow for the full year is expected to be at least $1 billion.
